As a result, the worker crashes and restarts constantly, delaying background tasks such as order confirmation emails.

truth.key_detail: the worker is OOM-killed (256 MB limit) and restarts in a loop because the sales_export job, since commit 7cca109, loads every order into memory instead of streaming one day in chunks
red_herrings: api commit capping search results, deployed about two minutes before the first worker kill
truth.expected_fix: revert the export to a chunked/streamed query limited to the reporting window (or compute all-time totals in SQL), then redeploy the worker
truth.notes: The worker is deployed on the culprit commit about ten minutes before the first kill; it only dies when the periodic export runs. No ERROR is logged by the worker: the evidence is repeated 'service started' and 'requeued interrupted jobs' lines, a sales_export 'job started' with no 'job finished', and oom_killed/restarts in containers.json. first_error_ts is the time of the first kill. db.log shows dropped client connections as a consequence.
